0022600201.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, 1-2 on the road) head into this away game after a loss and sit 11th in the West, while the LA Clippers (1-7) are on a seven-game losing streak and sit 13th. New Orleans is without Yves Missi, who is out with a knee bruise, and LA is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Isaiah Jackson (groin soreness), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Pelicans won the most recent meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026; they have not met yet in 2026-27.
